stem.text: An aircraft travels at a constant velocity of $90\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ in horizontal flight. The diagram shows some of the forces acting on the aircraft.

stem.alt: Diagram of an aircraft in horizontal flight with force arrows: drag 2400 N pointing left, thrust pointing right, and weight pointing down. Printed labels: drag, 2400 N, thrust, weight.

stem.text: The mass of the aircraft is $2000\,\text{kg}$.
What is the power produced by the thrust force?
